categories.main_business_segments: Gourmet Master Co. Ltd. primarily operates in the coffee, tea beverages, and bakery product manufacturing and retail sectors under the '85 Degrees C' brand. The company runs a chain of coffee bakery stores offering bread, pastries, and drinks, with a focus on fresh-baked goods and beverages. It also engages in franchising and retail operations across multiple regions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes product development with R&D teams in Taiwan, China, and the U.S., focusing on local taste adaptations and product innovation. Production involves centralized kitchens for trial and mass production, with standardized processes to ensure quality and efficiency. The company also integrates knowledge management to standardize production and facilitate training and expansion.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are general consumers seeking coffee, tea, and bakery products through retail stores and franchises. The company serves markets in Taiwan, China, the United States, and other regions, targeting urban consumers with preferences for fresh, high-quality bakery and beverage products.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations span Taiwan, China (including major cities like Shanghai, Beijing, Shenzhen, and others), the United States (notably California, Nevada, Texas, and New York), Australia, Malaysia, Hong Kong, and other international locations. The company maintains subsidiaries and branches across these regions to support retail and production activities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Gourmet Master Co. Ltd. operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on product development, manufacturing of bakery and beverage products, and retail distribution through company-owned and franchised stores. It manages procurement of raw materials but does not engage in upstream agricultural production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous product innovation tailored to local tastes, expansion of new store formats, and enhancement of digital payment and online-offline integration. R&D efforts focus on developing new bakery and beverage items, improving production standardization, and leveraging knowledge management to support growth and talent development. Sustainability and food safety are also strategic pillars.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of bakery products, beverages, and related items at retail stores and franchises. The company also earns income from franchising fees and licensing in various international markets. It integrates online and offline sales channels to capture delivery and digital payment opportunities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include Starbucks, Louisa Coffee, Dante Coffee, Cama Cafe, and other local and international coffee and bakery chains in Taiwan, China, and the U.S. The company positions itself as a leading coffee bakery chain with strong brand recognition, diversified product offerings, and competitive pricing, maintaining a leading market position especially in North America and Greater China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported net operating revenue of approximately NT$18.98 billion and operating profit of NT$1.14 billion, with a 3.7% increase in operating profit year-over-year. The U.S. market revenue surpassed US$250 million with sustained double-digit growth. The company maintains a stable financial position with positive cash flows and continues to invest in expansion and R&D, despite challenges in the China market.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Gourmet Master Co. Ltd. emphasizes delivering high-quality, freshly baked bakery products and beverages with innovative flavors tailored to local preferences. Its value proposition includes a strong brand presence across multiple regions, diversified product lines, and integration of digital payment and online-offline sales channels. The company also focuses on food safety, sustainability, and customer experience to differentiate itself in competitive markets.
